title: Business Development Executive
description:
Temporary Lead Generator / Business Development Executive

Part-Time or Full Time Immediate Start Temporary - Permanent

Upon application for this role you will receive a text message/email link to engage with our AI agent, please complete this to enhance your application

Candidates must hold a current Enhanced DBS certificate registered on the DBS Update Service.

Our client is seeking a confident and motivated Lead Generator / Business Development Executive to join their team on a temporary - permanent basis. This role is focused on generating interest in professional training programmes and building relationships with businesses through outbound calls.

The successful candidate will be comfortable speaking to decision-makers, identifying opportunities and promoting training solutions to potential customers. This is not a hard sales environment, but candidates should enjoy engaging with people, generating leads and supporting business growth.

Key Responsibilities
- Making outbound calls to businesses to introduce training and development opportunities.
- Generating interest and qualifying potential leads.
- Building and maintaining professional relationships with prospective clients.
- Promoting a range of training programmes and services.
- Updating internal systems and maintaining accurate records.
- Providing occasional administrative support as required.

Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience in telesales, lead generation, business development, customer service or a similar telephone-based role.
- Confident and professional telephone manner.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Good IT and administrative skills.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
- Available to start immediately.

Essential Requirement

Working Hours
- 22.5 hours per week
- Tuesday to Thursday
- Daytime hours
- Office-based role

Assignment Details
- Immediate start available
- Temporary assignment
- Duration to be confirmed and may vary depending on business requirements
- Basic training provided

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced sales or customer-focused professional looking for a flexible, part-time temporary position with an immediate start.

Candidates must hold a current Enhanced DBS certificate registered on the DBS Update Service.

We use generative AI tools to support our candidate screening process. This helps us ensure a fair, consistent, and efficient experience for all applicants. Rest assured, all final decisions are made by our hiring team, and your application will be reviewed with care and attention.
